verdict.rationale: Stagehand ships a documented integrations section in which each adapter gives an agent one persistent browser plus `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` tools. Dedicated pages cover CrewAI (v4 server-backed integration and the v3 StagehandTool), LangChain's Deep Agents (two deployment patterns), and Claude Code via MCP/stdio. missing for 10: explicit Vercel AI SDK adapter docs, an explicit Claude Agent SDK (rather than Claude Code) integration, a core LangChain adapter beyond Deep Agents, independent hands-on corroboration of the adapters.
